topic_en: Cargo: start a project, add dependencies, run tests

xhs.title: Rust 建项目到跑测试，一个工具全包
xhs.body:
第 14 课：Cargo
cargo new hello：生成 Cargo.toml 和 src/main.rs，cargo run 编译加运行
Cargo.toml 上面是项目信息，下面 [dependencies] 是依赖清单
cargo add anyhow：自动写进依赖，编译时从 crates.io 下载
函数上加 #[test]，用 assert_eq! 比较，cargo test 一起跑
考考你：#[test] fn check() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 5); } 跑 cargo test，结果是 ok 还是 FAILED？评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: One tool to start a Rust project, add libraries and run tests: Cargo. Quick quiz: #[test] fn check() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 5); }  Does cargo test say ok or FAILED? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: Four Cargo commands cover your daily Rust work
linkedin.body:
cargo new hello creates Cargo.toml and src/main.rs; cargo run builds and runs.
Cargo.toml holds the project info and the [dependencies] list.
cargo add anyhow writes the dependency for you; the next build downloads it from crates.io.
Mark a function with #[test], check with assert_eq!, and cargo test runs them all.
Quick quiz: #[test] fn check() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 5); }  Does cargo test say ok or FAILED? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: #[test] fn check() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 5); } 跑 cargo test，结果是 ok 还是 FAILED？
quiz.q_en: #[test] fn check() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 5); }  Does cargo test say ok or FAILED?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：FAILED。2 + 2 是 4，不等于 5，assert_eq! 会 panic，测试就算失败。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: FAILED. 2 + 2 is 4, not 5, so assert_eq! panics, and a panicking test fails.
